m: āḍhya mf(ā)n. (? fr. ārdhya, √ ṛdh; or fr. ārthya, NBD.), opulent, wealthy, rich, ŚBr. ix
rich or abounding in, richly endowed or filled or mixed with (instr. or in comp.), R.; Pañcat. &c.
a: āḍhya a. [ā-dhyai-ka-pṛṣo˚ Tv.] 1 Rich, wealthy; āḍhyo' bhijanavānasmi konyosti sadṛśo mayā Bg. 16. 15; Pt. 5. 8; Ms. 8. 169. 2 (a) Rich in, abounding in, possessing abundantly, with instr. or as the last member of comp.; satya˚ Pt. 3. 9 very truthful; vaṃśasaṃpallāvaṇyāḍhyāya Dk. 18; evamādiguṇairāḍhyaḥ Vet.; samudramiva ratnāḍhyaṃ Rām. (b) Mixed with, watered with; gaṃdhāḍhya; sraja uttamagaṃdhāḍhyāḥ Mb.; mūtrāḍhyaiḥ karaṃjaphalasarṣapaiḥ Suśr. 3 Abundant, copious. Comp. — āḍu a. striving to get wealth. — kulīna a. [āḍhyakule bhavaḥ kha] Descended from a rich family. — cara a. (rī f.) [bhūtapūrva āḍhyaḥ caraṭ] once opulent. — vātaḥ [āḍhyo vāto yatra] a convulsive or rheumatic palsy of the loins.
